description: Cisco Green Monitoring Stack collects operational sustainability metrics from network and data-centre equipment. The README names IOS-XR and NX-OS devices, Meraki switches, UCS compute, ACI controllers and power-distribution units among sample sources. Its dashboards connect device traffic and bandwidth with energy use, cost and carbon estimates at several aggregation levels. Users configure access to their own devices and external factors; output is monitoring data and charts, not a public equipment dataset. Geographic coverage follows the deployment. The repository states Apache-2.0 licensing. A limitation is that observed power and estimated emissions depend on telemetry, device coverage and electricity factors, and equipment manufacturing impacts are not established by this monitoring stack. It can supply measured digital-network loads to data-centre energy or telecom simulation. The related Brightway catalogue platform assesses life cycles from inventories, not running this operational collector. No monitoring data, device credentials or container images were obtained.
